author: Pnes
body:
Hello,

Today when I was playing on the server, some guy was being pretty annoying to the mods and he said how he was gonna leave before getting kicked or whatever. After that, one of the mods said "bye" and he was like "forcing me to leave huh" or something. I said something along the lines of "I'll force you to leave with some packets if you want" in a joking manner (I even said I was joking) and I was instantly banned. I didn't know making threats about ddosing was such a big deal and of course I wasn't being serious, I don't even know how to send a single packet (I've also seen others do it so I thought it wasn't a big deal). I also read the rules and there's nothing that talks about that, however I can see how it's wrong. I ask for an unban since I'm actually getting really interested in the server as of late and I'd like to keep playing. Sorry and thanks for your time.

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hello,

Although you may have been joking, DDoS threats are very serious. DDoSing other people is actually illegal in some places, too. This is not an official answer. You're going to have to wait for a Senior's opinion on the matter.

Excellence

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello.

So first off, I would like to remind you that DDoS threats are a very serious matter and is not a joking matter. You must understand that DDoSing others is illegal in some parts of the world, and is mainly frowned upon as a whole. 

Although the threat was not extremely serious or blatant, you should have not threatened anyone with a topic such as DDoS. 

Even though other servers may not have this rule, you must take it as common sense to not threaten someone like that. However, our rules unfortunately does not make a clear statement of the punishment in DDoS threats, which I apologize for. 

Therefore, I have come to the conclusion that you will NOT be unbanned. However, you may appeal again in a few months and your chances of being accepted will become greater. 

Sorry for any inconvenience.
Sincerely, 
MdnightBeats
Senior Moderator
